Class FormatHandler

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.format.FormatHandler
public class FormatHandler extends Object
The FormatHandler type is one named detector and renderer pair. FormatRouter tries the pair in registration order. The short ids used by the factory are json, fence, table, list, and markdown.
